executive_summary: Getinge delivered a challenging 2022 with organic sales declining 5.4% as COVID-related demand normalization impacted Acute Care Therapies. Total sales grew 4.6% to SEK 28,292 M due to currency effects. Adjusted EBITA declined to SEK 4,281 M (15.1% margin). Supply chain disruptions, component shortages and inflation pressured margins. Russia's invasion of Ukraine added complexity. Key acquisitions included Fluoptics for fluorescence imaging. New financial targets established for 2022-2025.
key_highlights: Adjusted EBITA SEK 4,281 M with 15.1% margin (vs 19.3% prior year)
Acute Care Therapies organic decline of 12.2% due to COVID normalization
Life Science and Surgical Workflows both grew organically 3.6%
Fluoptics acquisition completed in fluorescence imaging
67% of manufacturing sites EU MDR certified (vs 42% prior year)
Net debt reduced to SEK 2,602 M from SEK 3,609 M
Carbon emissions in own operations reduced 48% year-on-year

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Average annual organic growth in net sales: 4-6%
Average adjusted earnings per share growth: >10%
Dividend policy to pay dividends of 30-50% of net profit

challenges.challenge: Supply chain problems with component shortages and logistical difficulties
Russia's invasion of Ukraine impacting global trade
Healthcare not yet recovered to pre-pandemic elective surgery levels

honesty_signals: Openly acknowledges organic sales and order intake declined year-on-year
Admits cost increases from supply chain could not be fully compensated by price increases
Acknowledges future remains difficult to predict

key_quotes.quote: The organic order intake and net sales declined year-on-year in 2022. However, we still see many opportunities to develop our offering to meet customer needs and thereby expand our market shares

Together with our customers and suppliers, we are now working to create an improved work environment for healthcare staff with products that simplify their work, lead to increased productivity and save more lives
The future ahead remains difficult to predict, but we will likely continue to be faced with the global challenges that we experienced in 2022 some way into the new year

key_narratives: Post-pandemic normalization driving Acute Care Therapies decline
Supply chain disruptions and component shortages impacting production
Life Science and Surgical Workflows maintaining organic growth
Sustainability achievements with 48% carbon emission reduction in own operations
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views 2022 as a transition year following exceptional pandemic demand. Focus on addressing supply chain challenges while maintaining growth in non-COVID segments. Digital solutions and service business emphasized as future growth drivers.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Organic decline of 12.2% due to COVID-19 demand normalization. Lower ventilator demand vs exceptional 2021. Supply chain challenges impacted production. Anesthesia contract won with Premier Inc.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Organic growth of 3.6%. Recovery of products restricted during COVID-19. New production line for DPTE-BetaBags in Merrimack delivering. First business area to reach carbon neutral status.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Organic growth of 3.6%. Increased capital goods sales for operating rooms and sterile supply in US. IN2 modular room system and Aquadis 56 launched.

operational_highlights: Fluoptics SAS acquisition for fluorescence imaging
Aquadis 56 washer-disinfector launched with sustainability focus
Livit Flex bioprocess control system launched
New Experience Centers opened in Wayne and Frankfurt
concerns_mentioned: Whistle-blower investigation in Germany regarding HLS SET packaging
Consent Decree with FDA - Datascope added to decree

risks.risk: External shocks including geopolitical risks, pandemics, natural disasters
Quality risks from regulatory perspective - potential violations under investigation
Interruptions in supply chains and dependence on external suppliers
Digitization and innovation - ability to develop new successful products
Fragmented product portfolio lacking critical mass in some categories
Product liability risks - surgical mesh MDL settlement
Financial risks - currency, interest rate and credit risks

targets.notes: Average annual adjusted EPS growth target

guidance.commentary: New financial targets for 2022-2025 established. 2022 performance significantly below targets due to external headwinds and post-pandemic normalization.
